normalization_rules.operation: UTF-8 Markdown lines or DOCX body paragraphs and table rows in document order; NFKC fold, drop zero-width characters, Markdown heading/list/emphasis marks and table pipes (cells joined by colon, repeated merged cells collapsed), remove all whitespace
money amounts with 元/万元/人民币/¥ and thousands separators to one canonical yuan token; trailing zeros dropped (168万元 = 1,680,000元)
dates written as YYYY年M月D日 or YYYY-M-D, YYYY/M/D, YYYY.M.D to one ISO token

section headings resolved by alias plus whole-line structure (诉讼请求/诉讼请求事项/请求事项/诉请; 事实和理由/事实与理由/事实及理由/事实、理由/事实理由), optional leading numbering and trailing colon; more than one heading of a kind is unresolved; the facts section ends at a 此致/具状人/附件 line
statute article numbers 第X条 and paragraph numbers 第X款 in Chinese or Arabic numerals to article and paragraph tokens
fold declared gap markers and bracketed value-slot instructions into one gap token

quoted spans of 13 or more characters are replaced by an ellipsis token so quoted statutes or opponents' words never count as the author's assertion; directional quotes pair “…”/「…」, straight ASCII double quotes pair left to right on a line (1st with 2nd, 3rd with 4th), so author text between two short quotations is never folded

party labels 原告, 被告, 被告一/1, 第一被告, 被告(一), 第三人 resolve to roles; entity keys are the A-E公司 names at the head of the party value; a numbered defendant label naming one entity is rewritten to 被告<entity> in request and facts text
shape counter: non-whitespace characters of section body lines after N01, excluding headings, the document title and clauses containing a gap token

derivation_rules.operation: a span with six or more enumerated fragments mostly eight characters or shorter, a raw line of eight or more short whitespace- or comma-separated tokens, or a sentence with more than four distinct amounts or three distinct dates is spray and cannot be adopted
a span is not adopted when a negation precedes the key verb inside its clause, or it carries candidate/alternative markers, attributed or rejected speech, or a conditional
party entries: plaintiff set, defendant set, third parties; an entity in both plaintiff and defendant sets is mixed

termination request: request verb before a 合同…解除 phrase (not 解除通知/解除权), not negated and not a voidness declaration; effective point = 起诉状副本送达 or explicit dates; differing signatures across items are mixed candidates; the contract may be identified by its parties before the title (解除原告与(被告N)B公司…签订的《…合同》), and an explicit date immediately followed by 签订/订立/签署/签约/签定 identifies the contract and is not a termination date; a termination confined to part of the contract (…二期…部分, 部分解除) is recorded as partial scope and accepted when supported by the disputed unperformed obligations

subject resolution: an entity is a grammatical object when 向/对/给/与/致/通知/和/及/同 or the complement marker 作为 or the prepositional object markers 独立于/区别于/区分于/混同于 (optionally 原告/被告) directly precedes it; the payer of a damages request is the first non-object entity between the request verb and the compensation verb (赔偿/赔付/支付/给付 + loss object); a compensation predicate belongs to B公司 when B公司 is its nearest preceding non-object entity; the verb-to-loss-object window of a damages request is 20 characters (a project name may stand before the object)
capital occupation request accepts 资金占用费/利息/逾期付款损失/迟延付款损失 with supported start, LPR and actual-payment end
a cited article is attributed to the law name (民法典, 合同编通则…解释, 公司法, 合同法, 民事诉讼法) whose match ends nearest before it in the same paragraph

loss items: a loss block is a facts paragraph (at most 700 characters) where B公司 compensates plus the enumerated lines (at most 300 characters) that directly follow it; within a block, or a damages request item against B公司 split at , ; 。 、 and parentheses, a clause with a loss word or an enumerated entry binds design-fee, temporary-facilities, service-fee and expected-profit slots to the adjacent amount; clauses with a gap token are skipped; more than one distinct value per slot is ambiguous; in facts loss blocks a bid-service-fee amount followed in the same sentence by 分摊…amount is the allocation base, not a claimed loss amount
joint liability accepts explicit C subject or unambiguous nearby pronoun after C is identified as B sole shareholder

facts blocks: besides each single facts line, the conjunction predicate P13 is evaluated over every run of 2-4 consecutive non-heading facts lines inside one subsection whose joined text is at most 700 characters; heading lines (Markdown # headings, whole-bold lines, lines of at most 60 characters starting with 一、 or （一）) separate subsections and never join a block; lines are joined with a sentence stop so no pattern spans two lines, and every component must still come from an adopted, non-excluded sentence
